newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton steady in limited activity.
newsitem.headline: India cotton steady in limited activity.

text.p: Cotton prices held steady at the reduced level amid limited activity on the local market on Tuesday, dealers said.
Fresh mill buying remained sluggish but limited inflow kept prices quiet.

"Inflow of cotton from producing centres to the Bombay market remained at a low ebb due to disruption in the transportation system following recent riots which broke out in Bombay city and suburbs," one broker said.
"Trasnport operators are not willing to ply for Bombay market," he said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 945/1,000 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) after losing 50/55 rupees per maund on Monday.
Likewise Punjab saw-ginned was quiet at 1,800/1,840 rupees per maund and F-414 at 2,050/2,070 rupees per maund.
Gujarat varieties too remained steady in limited activity. Gujarat Kalyan was quiet at 14,000/14,300 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) as was Wagad cotton at 12,700/12,800 rupees per candy.
Overall market sentiment was subdued at the close of the session following reports of progress of monsoon in producing centres coupled with absence of fresh export quota by the Indian government.
"State-owned agencies may unload their unsold stock in the coming days amid expectations of higher new crop," a broker added.
